claims.text: FDA boxed warning for a possible link with malignancy, though there is no firm evidence of one
claims.quote: Topical calcineurin inhibitors include an FDA boxed warning because of the possible association between the medications and malignancies, despite no firm evidence that there is a link.

claims.text: Less effective than glucocorticoids but may avoid their complications on facial and intertriginous psoriasis.
claims.quote: They are not as effective as glucocorticoids but may avoid the complications of glucocorticoids when treating facial and intertriginous psoriasis.

claims.text: Lymphoma-risk data are mixed; evidence doesn't support higher skin cancer risk
claims.quote: Data from large cohort studies and meta-analyses evaluating the risk of lymphoma associated with topical calcineurin inhibitor use are mixed. Some studies have reported a small but statistically significant increase in lymphoma risk (2), while others have found no increased risk (3). In addition, the overall evidence does not support an increase in skin cancer risk.
